declarations.description:
Segmented ratio bar comparing two or three quantities, such as the bid/ask balance of an order book or the
win/draw/loss split of a record. `start-value` and `end-value` are raw amounts in any unit, and an optional
`middle-value` adds a third segment between them; the bar splits its width in proportion and, with `show-value`,
prints each share as a percentage: the start and end shares at their edges of the bar, the middle share centred
under its segment. The printed percentages always add up to 100. `start-label`, `middle-label` and `end-label` name
the segments for assistive technology, which reads the whole bar as one image ("Bid 22.43%, Ask 77.57%"). Override
any printed share through the `start`, `middle` and `end` slots.
declarations.name: ComparisonBar

cssProperties.description: Width of the whole component; the host is a block by default.
cssProperties.name: --c2-comparison-bar--width

cssProperties.description: Space between the edge percentages and the track.
cssProperties.name: --c2-comparison-bar--gap

cssProperties.description: Space between the track and the middle percentage.
cssProperties.name: --c2-comparison-bar__middle-value--margin-top

cssProperties.description: How long a segment takes to resize when a value changes.
cssProperties.name: --c2-comparison-bar--transition-duration

cssParts.description: Text region at the start edge containing the custom `start` slot or the start percentage fallback.
cssParts.name: start-value

cssParts.description: Text region under the middle segment containing the custom `middle` slot or the middle percentage fallback.
cssParts.name: middle-value

cssParts.description: Text region at the end edge containing the custom `end` slot or the end percentage fallback.
cssParts.name: end-value

slots.description: Replaces the start segment's percentage text (e.g. "Buy 22%").
slots.name: start

slots.description: Replaces the middle segment's percentage text. Only rendered when `middle-value` is set.
slots.name: middle

slots.description: Replaces the end segment's percentage text.
slots.name: end

members.name: startValue
members.description: Amount of the start segment (bids, buyers, wins). Negative values count as `0`.

members.name: middleValue
members.description: Amount of the optional middle segment (draws, abstentions). Leave unset for a two-segment bar.

members.name: endValue
members.description: Amount of the end segment (asks, sellers, losses). Negative values count as `0`.

members.name: startLabel
members.description: Name of the start segment, announced before its share.

members.name: middleLabel
members.description: Name of the middle segment, announced before its share.

members.name: endLabel
members.description: Name of the end segment, announced before its share.

members.name: showValue
members.description: Print each segment's percentage. Always on for a segment whose slot has content.

members.name: precision
members.description: Fraction digits of the printed and announced percentages.

members.name: locale
members.description: BCP 47 locale used to format the percentages; the document's locale when unset.

members.name: hasMiddle
members.description: Whether the bar has a middle segment.

members.name: shares
members.description:
Each segment's share in percent, rounded to `precision` so that they add up to exactly 100 (largest remainder).
The segments split evenly while none has an amount.

members.name: startPercent
members.description: Share of the start segment, `0` to `100`.

members.name: middlePercent
members.description: Share of the middle segment; `undefined` without a `middle-value`.

members.name: endPercent
members.description: Share of the end segment, `0` to `100`.
